The backyard area was very nice and great for the kids and adults and was really nice to go back and relax at after a day at the beach. The big thing is there is a lot of rules and so we were walking on egg shells the whole trip. Rules on not being able to use the pool or hot tub after 10pm and only being allowed to have music on low for the entire day at a level that couldn’t be heard upstairs or by the neighbours definitely killed the vibe a bit. There were limited towels provided for the pool and shower even though it is advertised for up to 8 people, and limited kitchen clothes provided so I would recommend bringing your own. The bathroom was also quite ran down. Debra was quite responsive to any questions that we had during the stay.
